headline:

kaspa cuts 17 times before then.

panes.title: WHAT CHANGES
lines: daily emission drops from 1.78 million to *1.68 million KAS*. no vote, no announcement.

post.x: the next kaspa reward cut lands in 1 day. bitcoin waits about 530 days for its next one, and kaspa cuts 17 more times before that date. daily emission drops from 1.78 million to 1.68 million KAS, the block reward from 2.0602 to 1.9445.
post.reply: the countdown runs on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the kaspa date is arithmetic, the bitcoin date is an estimate.
